controls: WASD move and drive, mouse orbit and aim, E interact / enter and steal cars, click shoot, F melee and rob, Space handbrake, R radio or reload, P city map, M mute, Esc pause
summary: A rain-soaked neon port city open-world crime game: third-person on foot and in cars, a twelve-mission story campaign for getaway driver Jax Rook and fixer Odile Vane, a 0-5 star wanted system with police interceptors and foot officers, pistol combat, traffic and pedestrian AI, six interactable shops, three safehouses that save the game, four synthesized radio stations, checkpoint races and courier runs, a live circular minimap and a full city map.
title: Velmara After Dark
